title: Agent Handoff Report
description: MVP_PLAN.md §25. Validation agents return findings as JSON so a hook can check the shape mechanically instead of a human reading prose and hoping.

owner.description: Who acts next. Never the reporting agent itself — see §27: a Reviewer that silently fixes its own finding has destroyed the separation the role exists for.

failure.description: One sentence stating the defect. Empty string when status is PASSED.

evidence.description: Reproduction evidence. Must be non-empty for FAILED — an unevidenced failure is an opinion, and §21 requires Validator to report evidence.

confidence.description: LOW combined with FAILED is the documented trigger to consider creating the Diagnostician (§25). It is a signal, not a disclaimer.
